title: Each owner ruling in a decision record carries his own words beside its rule text
why: Incident, 13:00 CST Nov 7: decision test-practices P5 said "ban every wall-clock wait", stronger than the owner's words. Two lanes, the coordinator and triage built page item 345 on it, and the owner had to correct it.
note: A check that each owner ruling in a decision record carries his verbatim words, or a cited quote, beside its rule text, so a paraphrase cannot drift past what he said. First check whether decision ruling-kind (lint/check_ruling_kind.py) or hooks/ruling_home.py already covers it, and extend that home if so. Done: the check goes red on a ruling line with no quote, and green on main.
